by
  refine ⟨{0}, (fun _ n => (n : ℝ)), (fun _ => 0), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx h
    exact continuousOn_const
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := h.1 0 (by simp)
    have hs : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (n : ℝ) < L + 1 :=
      hL.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (by linarith))
    have hb : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) :=
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop).eventually
        (eventually_ge_atTop (L + 1))
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := (hs.and hb).exists
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hn') hn
